name: Sampson Rock
generated_description:
Sampson Rock rises to 2,936 feet in Maryland. The Sampson Rock Trail covers 1.1 miles round trip (out-and-back) with about 187 feet of elevation gain — a gradual walk with modest climbing.

Getting There

The trailhead is at 39.67209, -78.92704 (tap for driving directions). It's roughly 80 miles southeast of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Arrive early on weekends — trailhead lots at popular peaks fill quickly, and cell service is often unreliable once you leave the highway.

When to Go

Spring through fall is the main season. Conditions change fast in the shoulder months — check a point forecast for the summit, not the nearest town, before you commit.

Know Before You Go

The Easy rating comes from the National Park Service difficulty formula, which weighs total distance against elevation gain. Most hikers should budget about 0.5 hours of moving time; add margin for breaks, photos and the descent. Download the GPX track from this page before you go — cell coverage is unreliable in the mountains and a saved route works offline in any GPS app. Conditions change: verify current access, closures and weather with the official land manager before you go. Trail data is sourced from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

Looking to link objectives or plan a weekend? Nearby summits include Saint John Rock, Mount Etna and Little Allegheny Mountain — each has its own guide on this site.

faqs.answer: Sampson Rock stands at 2,936 feet (895 meters) in Maryland.
